narrative.details:
Around these parts I am known as the Mithril Kid. I supply ornate mithril to adventurers from around the world.

<Trenton whispers.>

Little do they know that I do not know the technique to fashion ornate mithril gloves. Shhhh! This will be our little secret.

Teach me the technique to create ornate mithril gloves, adventurer, and in exchange, I will show you the resultant of the culmination of my training under Galvan: the ornate mithril breastplate.
narrative.objectives: Bring two Heavy Mithril Breastplates and one Ornate Mithril Gloves to Trenton Lighthammer.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Thank you for all that you have taught me, adventurer. The master and commander of the ornate mithril set will soon be in your possession.

Behold!
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you completed the crafting of the items, adventurer?
